question.worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic cotangent function is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arcoth}⁡x)=\frac{1}{1-{x}^{2}}.
$$

Using the formula above with the chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}[3\operatorname{arcoth}⁡(\sqrt[3]{x})] \\  & =\frac{3}{1-{(\sqrt[3]{x})}^{2}}\cdot {(\sqrt[3]{x})}^{′} \\  & =\frac{3}{1-\sqrt[3]{{x}^{2}}}\cdot \frac{1}{3\sqrt[3]{{x}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{1}{{x}^{2/3}}\frac{1}{(1-\sqrt[3]{{x}^{2}})}.\end{aligned}
$$
